objective: Repair live Android mentor teaching-report access and CCP5 lesson selection, with secure audited mentor grants and account-scoped lesson completion receipts; prepare a strictly gated production Android OTA candidate without deploying.
productionBaselineEvidence: Source-only: inspected GitHub main production config on 2026-11-21; package org.mzbministry.buklod, EAS project 23dad7d0-389a-406e-8dec-08965dab85d8, configured runtimeVersion 1.3.2. Installed binary/update ID and live API response not independently attested. chosenApproach: Forward-port only seven isolated DEV paths plus a security-hardening trigger, one SQL contract and one scope manifest to a fresh main-based RC hold. Do not merge 139 unrelated DEV commits, deploy SQL to production, mutate identity permissions or release OTA until isolated DB/CI/Android gates pass.
selectionRationale: The source branch is diverged from main. Mentor catalog RPC currently returns [] for all users because there are no active mentor capabilities, and the Admin relationship editor can assign learners without granting mentor capability. An audited, explicitly reviewed admin-only capability path preserves protected official identity and avoids accidental BP awards.
alternativeApproaches: Merge divergent Season 2 DEV branch directly to production (rejected: hundreds of unrelated unverified changes).
Automatically reactivate five inactive mentor capability records (rejected: unclear revocation history, least privilege).
Publish JS-only OTA before SQL dependency (rejected: admin activation fails and source/back-end diverge).
preserveBehaviors: No live production DB/OTA/APK changes before release gate.
Preserve all historical mentor assignments and teaching reports; no backfill/automatic BP awards.
Preserve private photo storage, verified learner roster, and idempotent report RPC.
Maintain system-admin protections and all app-wide AdMob navigation and compact-spacing gates.
No new native dependencies or changes to app.config.js, eas.json, package-lock.json.
